Crew members visit markets and shops in the districts they choose, show owners how a NextaStore shop works on their own phone, and help them get started. When a store they brought pays, they earn a reward, and their rate grows as they rank up by bringing in stores that stay. Crew members also get field tools such as lead logging, a map of where the marketplace is thin, campaigns, and a pitch kit. Places are approved by NextaStore. Crew requires an application and approval, and is for people who will work the field. Crew members earn at higher rates that rise with rank, and get field tools: logging a business so it is held for them, working offline, a district map, campaigns with a leaderboard, and a pitch kit. Each account joins one program at a time. A Circle member who wants more can ask to move up to Crew.

Your Crew page shows your progress toward unlocking it. The photo can be replaced while applying and while the card is still locked. Once the card is released the photo is fixed, so ask support if it really needs changing.

answer: The ID photo and the face photo for the Crew card are stored privately, are never shown publicly, and are used only to review the application and make the card. Only authorised NextaStore staff reviewing applications can open the ID.

questions: Can I move from Circle to Crew
Upgrade to crew
Move up to crew
Switch from circle to crew
Change from circle to crew
I am in circle and want crew
Circle member apply for crew
answer: Yes. A Circle member can ask to move up to Crew from their Circle page. The request needs the same details as a Crew application, including the ID and card photo, and a NextaStore admin approves it. Your Circle membership keeps working until then, and a declined or withdrawn request changes nothing. Your balance, payout number, withdrawals and history carry over, since it is the same account. On approval you get a new Crew code, and your old Circle code, link and QR code keep working. Stores that signed up under your Circle link before approval stay on Circle rewards, and stores that sign up after approval earn Crew rewards. You cannot be in both programs at once, which is why the move is an upgrade.

If you entered a wrong number, correct it in your dashboard, and contact support if a withdrawal was already requested to the old number.
